title: Concept: Response header built from input (php) — review required
description: In php, header("X-N: " . $_GET['n']) places a computed value in a response header. CR and LF bytes end the header early, letting the remainder become new headers or body. The remedy is strict value validation (a token-charset allowlist).
applicability: php response paths setting headers from parts; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Response splitting: header injection, cache poisoning, script injection; MEDIUM severity (frameworks mitigate).
